scope: All 96 existing branches for the two requested states; 0 new simulation/model calls/training
time_axis: h=0 is captured state; action[h] produces observation[h+1]; original episode index=h+61 or h+56
events: first leaving initial cell and first return; cardinal x thresholds do not encode torque direction
sustained_low: 10 consecutive observations with head<0.6 or torso_zz<0.3
sustained_pair_position: first 20 consecutive observations with |paired root x difference|>=0.5m, signed difference also retained
sustained_pair_action: first 20 consecutive actions with between-policy RMS difference>=0.2 per actuator; descriptive only
comparison: common saved follow-up RNG; no causal attribution from differing actions at already divergent states
